content.title: Pie Day in the Mile High: Where to Grab a Slice in Denver - 98.5 KYGO
content.text: Whether you prefer fruit-filled crusts or decadent chocolate cream, March 14 is the sweetest day of the year. In honor of Pi Day (3.14), local bakeries across the Front Range are offering special deals that are sure to satisfy your cravings. As your friends here at KOSI 101.1, we want to make sure you have the perfect treat to celebrate. Here is where you can snag a slice of the action today: Village Inn: Known for their “Best Pie in America,” participating Village Inn locations are offering a free slice of classic fruit pie with the purchase of any entrée. It’s a Denver staple for a reason, and a great way to cap off your lunch or dinner. Whole Foods Market: If you are looking to take a full pie home, Whole Foods is offering $3.14 off any full-sized bakery pie. Perfect for sharing—or keeping all to yourself. Oskar Blues Grill & Brew: Looking for a savory twist? Some locations have been known to offer discounts on their famous beer-infused pies. It’s worth calling your local spot to see if they’re participating in the mathematical festivities. Local Bakeries: Don’t forget to check your neighborhood favorites! Spots like Hinman’s Bakery in Denver often lean into the holiday spirit. Give your local shop a quick call or check their Instagram pages—small businesses love celebrating the day just as much as we do. If you’re like me, March 14 isn’t just about the sweet stuff—it’s the perfect excuse to grab a “pizza pie.” Blaze Pizza: Blaze is bringing back their annual tradition. Download the Blaze Pizza app and snag a 10-inch pizza for just $3.14 at participating locations. It’s the ultimate way to celebrate without breaking the bank. 7-Eleven: If you’re on the go, the 7-Eleven app is offering a large pepperoni or cheese pizza for $3.14 for their rewards members. It’s a quick, easy way to join in the fun during your commute. Pieology: For the custom-pizza lovers, Pieology is offering a special “Buy One, Get One” deal on artisan-style thin-crust pizzas for members of their loyalty program. It’s a great excuse to treat a coworker to lunch. Marco’s Pizza: Check the Marco’s website or app today—they are featuring a “Pi Day” special where you can get a large one-topping pizza for $9.18 (a nod to the 3.14 math theme). Use code “PIDAY” at checkout to snag the discount. Your Neighborhood Joint: Denver is home to some incredible independent pizzerias. From Cart-Driver to Blue Pan Pizza, it never hurts to check their social media pages. Many of our local favorites run “math-themed” promos or surprise discounts for walk-in customers today. A quick tip from your friends at KOSI 101.1: Since today is one of the busiest days of the year for pizza shops, try to place your order online early or head in during off-peak hours to avoid the rush. Whatever you choose, make sure to grab your slice early, as these deals tend to disappear faster than a fresh cherry pie on a windowsill. Happy Pi Day, Denver! We hope your afternoon is as sweet as that first bite. For more local updates and your favorite music, keep it locked to KOSI 101.1.
